summary: The 16-path design covers most handler/authority/transaction work but cannot satisfy rejection backup roundtrips with the current protected reader. findings.title: Global legal rejection becomes unbackable without status-dependent request proof

findings.consequence: A lawful rejection can poison the new public backup/restore path. No SQL or test was run to claim a reproduced runtime failure.

Preserve original request SID, original rejection journal and identity; do not create a fake session, drop the identity, clear response SID or weaken successful session proof.

root_followup_decisions_observed.decision: For new authenticated commands, sole idempotency INSERT headers may store private schema/encoding/base64 raw-envelope record. No new SQL/table/authority, backfill or UPDATE; exact18 proposal revision then independent scope review.

private_original_request_record.location: idempotency.headers on new v2 journal INSERT only
private_original_request_record.scope: New authenticated, strictly decodable and schema-valid commands, including legal typed rejection. Never HTTP response headers or logging material; reject credential plaintext keys by frozen request schema, never introduce credential intake here.
reader_order: Bound header byte length before parsing and decoding. Strict JSON UTF-8/duplicate/Unicode checks and exactly schema,encoding,raw_envelope_base64 string keys; exact version and encoding. Require the chosen canonical compact outer serialization so whitespace/escape aliases cannot bypass the size bound.

Use strict standard padded base64 decoding, bound decoded raw to 1..1MiB, and require encode(decoded)==stored text. Reject whitespace/newlines, alternate alphabet, missing/extra padding, nonzero unused bits, nonstrings or unknown fields.

Retain original raw bytes in the decoded envelope before any map/marshal normalization; strict duplicate/unknown/Unicode/type checks and full frozen CommandEnvelope input schema. Do not use json.RawMessage Marshal as a byte-preservation mechanism.

Recompute the existing full Envelope.ContentHash(), including scope/method/client/payload, against BOTH journal.request_hash and globalidentity.request_hash. request_hash is this existing canonical semantic hash, NOT SHA256(raw bytes). Preserve the original bytes separately; do not change the legacy hash algorithm or claim raw-byte-equal equivalent JSON retries.

Match journal/global principal+command, protocol, project, method, operation and exact response identity. Ordinary response SID equals original request SID; only successful session.create has the proven derived-SID rule; project goal.start keeps null top SID and validates nested real creation when successful.

Only a fully proven REJECTED record gets the narrow no-existing-Session exception. Its response still satisfies full frozen schema, original requested scope and SID, error/result rules and exact replay. No permission or Session is created by the rejection.

COMPLETED/ACKNOWLEDGED and malformed/unknown statuses retain strict persisted Session/project/derived creation proof. Missing or malformed new private record is not a reason to exempt anything. Legacy empty or unrelated old headers retain old reader rules; do not backfill or reinterpret arbitrary v1 HTTP headers.

New record corruption, missing identity, changed payload/project/client/SID/method/command/hash or response mismatch fails backup; restoration cannot manufacture the request. Whole-history/header validation runs before bounded status projection.
private_original_request_record.source_evidence: 0002_domain.sql idempotency.headers TEXT NOT NULL has no length CHECK. The inspected backup_host_configuration reader currently has no header length bound. The new bounded common reader and caller can fit existing exact18; no SQL edit required.
private_original_request_record.limits: Immutable local journal and relational/hash checks are provenance within the existing trust model, not a new signature that authenticates wholesale adversarial rewriting of every trusted row.

fixed_contract_and_core_conditions.condition: Keep ConfigurePayload exactly revision/provider/base_url/model/nullable credential, ConfigureResult=ModelConfiguration verified_at=null. Default scope has four explicit nulls; scoped has all project/session/revision/epoch. No invented credential/session/result fields. Saving never qualifies/probes/starts a worker.

null credential saves an unverified immutable config. Nonnull metadata checks ref/provider/kind/revocation in actual same Host/OS identity/bound principal; do not decrypt, expose Wrapped/MaterialDigest or read another vault. The actual MODEL dispatch credential check remains mandatory after save; null/unusable config cannot inherit a usable qualified route.

Actual Host object supplies stable InstanceID and verified SID/boundPrincipal metadata only; DB current OWNER/grants/workspace/session checks use the caller transaction. No second DB transaction, fake PID authority or Host string trust. Inject identical port in both initial no-runtime and final runtime compositions.

Authenticate first, strict raw/schema before writes, global principal+command lookup before CAS; conflicting full request rejects across method/project/client/payload. Exact existing replay does not reserve/backfill. New identity is outside business SAVEPOINT but inside original outer transaction. Legal rejection rolls back business and commits only legitimate identity+journal; schema/IO/commit failure rolls all back. One original response, no second journal.

Exact session.control ACK reaches original finalizer; do not early-return global lookup around it. Current immutable idempotency UPDATE/1811 F08 issue remains open and raw failures must be distinguished from handler gates; no trigger change here.

Every new successful configure, including same payload/new command, advances owner+principal head exactly once and creates a fresh immutable ref. Scoped save atomically CASes current Session revision+writer epoch and increments revision once; no watermark/Run/profile rewrite, no retry after CAS loss. Historical records validate original request/result revision, not current Session/head equality.

Check real pending Task with no Run, leases, children/process fences, effect STARTED/UNKNOWN, queue commands/consumption/drop receipts, pending cancel and permission requests. Include older associated unresolved effects/controls, not only current Run or optimistic terminal/queue_empty labels. No-run draft with no pending Task is distinct from pending Task/noRun.

Use exact successful original creation journal attribution and subsequent successful scoped-configuration chain for this Session. A different Session using the same ref grants no authority. Missing/contradictory typed config/history is corruption, not legacy. A genuine legacy branch needs original causal profile proof; read/replay does not grant execution. Rebind creates new typed proof only for future work.

Keep sessionModel(project,ref) a profile/route resolver, not an existential Session authorizer. Put exact Session-context checks in public dispatch/write/send/rebind and runtime AdmitTurn/sessionTaskRoute. Check existing session-scoped goal.start before protected startClientGoal calls context-poor checkClientBinding. For workspace.write, existing outer Session/workspace and frozen Task profile proof must remain effective. If a necessary caller cannot be covered in these boundaries, register the named additional caller before editing.

Current valid head selects that exact ref; corrupt/unavailable head cannot fall back to old qualified route. Truly absent head may use original unique current legacy route for new creation, without claiming historical profile proof for a resulting noRun draft. Preserve draft zero Task/Run/effect and all old immutable history; subsequent execution of an unanchored Session remains refused until explicit typed rebind.

Validate complete durable history before projecting head once plus newest99 distinct nonhead refs, deterministic revision/ref order; credential summaries deduplicate only selected refs, max100, metadata only. No pruning, invented history API or loss of authorized older exact-ref lookup. New status principal raw; legacy prefixed replay bytes remain unlinked unchanged.

Only openai-completions; absolute HTTPS, no userinfo/query including lone ?/fragment including lone #, encoded or dot/double-slash path; reject completed chat/completions suffix including case variants and optional slash. Store exact base bytes and derive one endpoint via one trailing-slash trim plus /chat/completions; compare exact runtime profile/provider endpoint. New proposal must enumerate scheme/host case, explicit port, IPv6/zone and IDN behavior rather than leave canonical serialization pending. No URL probes or fallback.

PC01_caller_scope_decision.must_not: Do not label missing row/prefix/time/head as legacy or turn a new current profile into proof of old creation. Do not create a Task merely to give a draft an anchor.
